title: HUD work for ship data
body: Working on the ship-data HUD: energy, heat, propellant and speed across the top, defenses on the left, and crew, reserves and system status on the right. Recent-history graphs sit below the ship view. This screenshot shows the depleted-propellant state.

images.alt: Ship-status HUD with resource gauges, defenses, crew and system readouts, and recent-history graphs around a ship model.
